1:10.note: Order of gold and silver bowls reversed.

2:1.note: Ketiv/Qere mapped; 'the exile' omitted; adds 'and carried them' and 'went'.

2:10.note: Number differs: one hundred for six hundred.

2:26.note: Number differs: seven hundred for six hundred.

2:36.note: Number differs: seven hundred for nine hundred.

2:55.note: 'servants of Solomon' read as names 'sons of Abar, sons of Shalim'.

2:63.note: 'the heads of Israel' for Tirshatha; 'ask and see' for Urim and Thummim.

2:68.note: 'and stood' loosely for 'to set it up on its site'.

3:3.note: Adds 'great' and 'who dwell in the cities'; Ketiv/Qere mapped.

3:7.note: Tyrians and Sidonians reversed; 'as Cyrus wrote' for 'grant'.

3:9.note: 'Hodaviah' for Judah; order of sons and brothers swapped.

3:10.note: Expanded: 'holding horns of rams and blowing them'.

3:12.note: Adds 'this in its glory'; 'in their eyes' omitted.

3:13.note: 'sound of horns' for 'shout of joy'; adds 'of weeping'.

4:2.note: 'we build' for 'we seek'; Ketiv/Qere mapped; 'Sarhadom' for Esarhaddon.

4:7.note: Ketiv/Qere mapped; 'asked in peace' for Bishlam.

4:20.note: Tribute clause replaced by 'the former kings counted them as nothing'.

5:1.note: Ketiv/Qere mapped; Jerusalem and Judah reversed.

5:8.note: Expanded descriptions of stones and work; ܕ of ܕܐܙܠܢ = די, לבית not rendered (ܕܐܠܗܐ = אלהא only).

5:11.note: 'their princes finished it' for 'a great king built it'.

6:7.note: 'governor of the Jews' omitted; adds 'that they may do it'.

6:10.note: 'sacrifices' for 'sweet savours'; 'for the king' for 'for the life of the king'.

6:11.note: Adds 'they shall make him a stake'.

6:12.note: 'to alter' rendered 'to change and to destroy'.

6:16.note: 'sons of Judah' for 'sons of the exile'.

6:22.note: 'house of the Lord' for 'house of God'.

7:5.note: 'the chief' moved to start of next verse.

7:6.note: 'head' from 7:5; 'gifts as he wished to walk in the law of the Lord' for 'according to the hand of the Lord'.

7:7.note: 'those who minister' for singers; adds 'those who went up'.

7:9.note: 'one' of first month omitted; 'they began to go up'.

7:14.note: Paraphrase: 'I commanded ... and sent from my relatives to inquire'; ܡܢ ܩܪܝܒܝ together for ושבעת יעטהי.

7:15.note: 'from the will of my mind I offered'.

7:16.note: Paraphrase about those who wish to go with you; עם read as 'with you' (ܥܡܟ).

7:23.note: Paraphrase with doubled 'law of God'; first ܕܐܠܗܗ = אלה (5), second ܕܐܠܗ ܫܡܝܐ taken as אלה שמיא of 10-11; לבית omitted.

7:24.note: Free rendering of singers and tribute.

8:4.note: 'governor' rendered 'dominion'; Eliehoenai split into two names.

9:1.note: 'elders' for princes; 'impurity' for abominations; order of nations varies.

9:4.note: 'those to whom it was grievous'; 'nine hours' for evening offering.

9:6.note: 'we are ashamed' for 'I am ashamed and confounded'.

9:7.note: Expanded: ܡܛܠ ܕܐܣܓܝܢ ܠܡܚܛܐ as a group for ובעונתינו; adds 'enemies' and 'fathers'.

9:9.note: 'gave us God to mercy' for 'extended mercy'; adds 'daily'.

9:11.note: 'unclean' for 'land of impurity'; order of clauses varies.

9:13.note: 'you thought to forgive our sins' for 'punished less than our iniquities'.

10:8.note: 'all' omitted; 'people of Israel' for 'congregation of the exile'.

10:9.note: 'it was' and 'because of the rain' omitted; adds 'of the Lord'.

10:12.note: Expanded: 'we accept all you say'; Ketiv/Qere merged.

10:14.note: 'elders' for princes; 'time of prayer' for appointed times.
